ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; dominant low-intensity (black) central region covering approximately 65% of the visible surface, contrasted by high-intensity (white) peripheral distal tips and scattered high-intensity circular motifs.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally located dark pigmentation zone extending from the peduncle connection to the trailing edge across both lobes. Distal lobes exhibit high-intensity white pigmentation. The dark field is populated by numerous high-intensity (white) circular and annular clusters (rosettes) primarily concentrated in the medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, obtuse U-shaped depression at the convergence of the lobes; depth estimated at less than 5% of total lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serrated profile along the trailing boundary; variations consist of irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 2-10 pixels in amplitude relative to the primary contour line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a broadly convex trajectory from the median notch, tapering to acute, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial distribution of roughly circular white pixel clusters (barnacle scars) across the central dark pigment; clusters exhibit varying diameters and internal intensity gradients (rings).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple white, unaligned linear pixel disruptions; a notable cluster of four parallel diagonal rake marks is visible on the medial-right lobe (viewer's perspective) within the dark pigmented zone.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring patterns including circular barnacle attachment marks and linear rake-like abrasions distributed across the dark ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'starlit' texture produced by the extreme density of high-contrast white rosettes against the deep black central pigmentation field.
